label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said expectations are unclear. What is happening?
Every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent, but without a set priority order, I waste time asking around. Because of this, I sometimes miss my daily SAP quota by about 20 invoices.
What would help you know which invoices to prioritize first?
A simple priority order from my lead, or one person who decides, would help me know what to tackle first.

Here is what I will tell HR: Competing urgent invoice requests without a set priority order result in wasted time and missed daily quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY] "Every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent, but without a set priority order, I waste time asking around."
